A_spec_behavior.details: The fixture is an owned title-only blank HTML page. The focused producer test invokes real runScrape and articleToMarkdown: content_markdown is falsy and the formatter emits the intended explicit fallback, while populated referrals content remains populated and has no fallback. Native warm and post-reload paths each require the blank-page URL state, empty body, trusted Fast capture, visible Article tab with the exact fallback, revisit from SEO with an identical pane snapshot, and unchanged full capture export identity/payload. The completeness gate requires Article evidence at both phases while retaining six-pane capture invariance and the existing Images/Video/Links empty checks.

B_quality.details: Assertions are fail-capable: the helper requires the fallback and unchanged pane/export; tests reject unexpected article text, changed pane snapshot, changed export payload, and missing reload Article evidence. The native UI cannot show an Article tab without a current capture, and the test requires selected visible Article content with the formatter fallback after Fast capture, preventing the no-capture empty prompt from masquerading as the fallback. Ordering keeps existing warm cases before the new blank capture and runs post-reload empty checks before the existing deep-capture path.

limitations: No native/browser execution was performed; no T08 acceptance credit.
An initial Vitest invocation used unsupported --minWorkers and was rejected before tests; rerun with the repository Vitest-supported single-worker flags passed.
Existing Scrape B reload failure remains separate and is not attributed to the Article addition.
